value.rationale: Different species prices are inherent in heterogeneous sensor deployment. The result distinguishes two geometric mechanisms, yields a complete natural 1-parameter exact design classification and a first-order optimizer discontinuity, and supplies a sharp critical price and slope jump. This is mathematically substantive relative to the isolated previously known equal-price minimum, not a mere subcase recomputation.
